# Controlled owning workflow

Use this closure in the joined-response recovery tests. `manifest.json` records
original paths, hashes and the eda5c08a9fbcc4a308537b17f0b9547108fbc748 origin.
The fixture assembler copies byte-identical common definitions from tracked
source and the differing definitions from this directory into a temporary owner.
Its real clean signed commit supplies preparation identity. CI needs no private
worktree or historical Git object.

The relative `Ticket/control.ts` dependency remains model-aware. The original
extractor rejects the controlled narrated reply before the recovery overlay loads
the repaired canonical parser. `package.json`, `text-storage.ts` and
`native-node.ts` preserve the module context of that relative dependency.

The pinned continuation's dormant model branch needs `Ticket.SelectModel` during
native syntax preflight. Its exact pinned definition is test-only; the source
boundary fails if expansion actually invokes it. Continuation supplies no model
selection props and proves ordinary Step forwarding to the original Haiku session.

`git-boundary.ts` observes real signed fixture repositories through the workflow-local public host. The native CLI uses its `Git.Changes`
forwarding component for that same boundary. `no-dispatch.ts` rejects any provider
prompt or role dispatch during reconciliation. Native File and rename cuts live
in the shared test support; selection, validators, snapshots, Advance and Publish
remain production components.

The workflow-owned runtime suite uses one public TestAgent controller and session store across independent original, feedback and correction roots. Each declared logical session has its own scripted route. Host settlement receipts are written only after execution scope cleanup joins. The immediate JoinedResponseRecovery.test.md launches the nested suite and eight native boundaries; Node runs the same suite with its own public CLI launcher. Historical Submit bytes are retained separately under ../historical-submit with exact source provenance and hashes.

Run the discovered owner with:

```bash
deno task test examples/adversarial-implementation/tests/JoinedResponseRecovery.test.md
pnpm exec tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.node.json --test --test-concurrency=1 examples/adversarial-implementation/tests/runtime/joined-response-recovery-suite.ts
```

Ordinary workflow assertions execute in public in-process roots. Only the named native-entry probes launch the CLI. The explicit Node probe also uses a real Node child when its test runner is Deno. Deno launch vectors force manual dependency layout, cached inputs and a frozen lock so checks do not perform preparation.
